about_the_game:
THIS CHRISTMAS COULD BE YOUR LAST!

Welcome to Forced Entry a realistic horror escape sim about a girl who goes to stay at her estranged fathers mansion on Christmas week with her 2 friends in the quiet town of Newbridge where a serial killer has been active in the area for the past 2 years.

After a night of partying in town with your friends you head back to the house for the after party however someone else is waiting inside the house for you to arrive. After getting knocked out you awake in the basement with a masked killer walking the hallways of the house. You must escape before its to late but it won't be easy.

- SOLVE PUZZLES 
- FIND TOOLS AND KEYS 
- DISCOVER SECRET AREAS  
- AVOID NOISY FLOORBOARDS
- USE STEALTH TO AVOID BEING SPOTTED

Navigate a big house with dark corners everywhere and danger could lurk at any moment one wrong step and it will be your LAST CHRISTMAS
